biological_reference.divergence: SD-106 implements a FORMAL, task-agnostic objective -- generic (1 - R^2) variance/reconstruction preservation, scale-normalised, via a separate linear decoder -- as a proxy for 'the encoder should not discard input structure'. recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Do NOT bump preservation_weight, and do not re-run the full acceptance measurement yet (the driver's own null_reading and this autopsy both refuse a same-weight or different-weight requeue). First resolve the training-budget/metric-mismatch question with a cheap, P0-warmup-only diagnostic (no decoder ladder, no oracle-adapter dataset collection): on the SAME frozen SD-106 latent, at weight=200, read BOTH (a) `preservation_holdout.r2` (the in-training SGD-trained-head holdout metric this run already reports) AND (b) a post-hoc OLS linear-probe R^2 fitted the same way the design-time 0.9974/0.9978 figures were obtained (per SD-106 substrate doc Sec. 'Measured effect' methodology), across a step-budget arm: as-shipped (348-396 steps, raise nothing), ~600 steps (raise zworld_p0_episodes or epochs to match the design doc's own reference point), and ~1200 steps. Three attributable outcomes: (1) post-hoc R^2 already ~0.99 at the shipped budget -> the metrics were simply never comparable, the mechanism and budget are both fine, and the DV shortfall is a genuine objective-choice question (promote the /lit-pull on generic-vs-task-relevant compression to primary); (2) post-hoc R^2 low but rising with budget -> under-budgeted P0a, fix the budget and re-run the acceptance measurement; (3) post-hoc R^2 low and flat across budget -> a genuine mechanism/implementation defect, needs a build fix before any re-validation. Do NOT reuse a bare re-read of `preservation_holdout.r2` alone as the probe -- it is deterministic under the same seeds/code and would simply reproduce 0.70-0.75 without discriminating among these three cases.

This is NOT directly comparable to the design-time 0.9974/0.9978 figures, which are a different, post-hoc linear-probe metric (Step 7c red-team finding); whether more training budget would close the gap, or the shortfall is a genuine ceiling of the objective, is open -- see implementation_hint.

learning_extracted: SD-106-ON improves consumer-rung oracle-action agreement over the paired OFF arm by 0.037-0.072 absolute on all 3 seeds -- some bottleneck-preservation pressure helps, consistent with V3-EXQ-1010's diagnosis -- but the specific built shape (`preservation_weight=200` + skip) falls ~0.14 short of the PCA-32 anchor and clears the pre-set 0.85 bar on 0/3 seeds.

The SD-106 preservation head's own P0a training budget in this run (348-396 steps on 2364-2716 buffered observations, driven by `ZWORLD_P0_EPISODES=60`) is well below the SD-106 design doc's own stated reference point (600 steps, ~4000 buffered observations); the head's final training loss (74-78) sits far above the OFF arm's baseline (19). Whether this budget shortfall (rather than the objective's design) explains the DV shortfall is open and cheaply testable -- see the recommended diagnostic.

The SD-106 design doc's headline proxy figures (0.9974/0.9978 'obs R^2' at weight=200) are a POST-HOC linear-decodability probe, methodologically distinct from `preservation_holdout.r2` (the in-training SGD-trained head's own holdout R^2, gated on `self._preserve_head is not None` and null on every OFF cell in this manifest). Comparing the two directly, as an earlier draft of this autopsy did, is a category error -- caught by the Step 7c cross-model red-team pass, which correctly rejected the 'reproduction gap' framing on a one-line read of the code gate and the design table's own rows.

The design doc's proxy-calibration figures (both the 0.9974/0.9978 table and the 0.9652 'shipped recipe' figure it is compared against) were never captured as a reproducible, committed experiment artifact -- no script under `experiments/`, no manifest, no `substrate_hash`. This recording gap is real and independent of the metric-mismatch finding above; it means a future design decision resting on a proxy number should mint a minimal committed script for it, per the Experimental Recording Standard.

Whether the untangling reference calls for generic or task-relevant/selective compression remains open and lit-groundable, but resolving it before the training-budget question above is understood would risk drawing a biology-level conclusion from what may simply be an under-trained P0a warmup.
